title: My Mallworld
content: Even if nobody see this hopefully getting it off my chest will help me feel more at ease. Never heard "Mallworld" before but have had similar dreams to many people in this sub. For as long as I can remember my dreams have always been vivid, I can remember dreams from when I was a child/teen. I've had a few lucid dreams without even trying. When I try and focus on having a lucid dream it doesn't come to me. Some I was able to actually control myself and what I was doing, in others I know I'm dreaming but just let the dream continue without trying to control it. My uncle and grandma both passed away 2 months apart about 15 years. I was super close to both of them. I've only had maybe 2 dreams about my grandmother. Also looking at her from behind. The one dream she was wearing exactly what she was buried in, but she was in her house. She wouldn't look at me or speak to me and I was unable to move to look at her, even knowing it was a dream I couldn't control anything. On the other hand my uncle I've had a few dreams about, mainly when I was pregnant. I went to a medium a few years after he died and recorded it. I had a few dreams of something vibrating in my house but I always too nervous to look. One night I had the same dream but this time I looked for what was vibrating and it was a tape recorded. I remember telling myself "If you press play and don't like what you hear you will be stuck in your dream" I pressed play anyway and it was the recording from my reading. It was me saying "I always feel him around me, I know he's with me" and the dream ended shortly after that. I never saw him but I knew it was about him. In one he was watching me and my family from afar just smiling at me, nobody else could see him. It's been over two years since I had that dream and it still makes me cry (haven't dreamt about him since) I've had a dream about a zombie apocalypse that lasted literally 2 weeks. Every dream would pick up right where the other left off like I was being transported to another world. I've had a few other zombie apocalypse dreams after that. Im always stuck in a building or a city. I use to swim for my high school swim team so I have many dreams about the pool/locker room. Always thought they were memories I was reliving but looking back they're always so dark and gloomy. The locker room, is dark and dingy, almost never ending. When I finally make it I'm in the pool area which seems distorted... The worst ones are when I'm stuck inside my elementary school and high school hallways. No matter how fast I run my legs barely move or I'm constantly tripping over my own feet. I cant find my class, or where to go or how to leave the building. And if I do figure out how to leave it's always dark and gloomy in these dreams as well. That's one common dominator in all my dreams, it's always dark and gloomy like it's about to thunderstorm at any second. It feels like an alternate universe to the one I'm currently in but a dark version. Lately I've been having dreams about leaving my boyfriend. Or that I'm cheating on him right in front of his face and I have no remorse at all. Even when I wake, I don't feel guilty, I could careless. I actually wake up longing for the other person... it's making me super depressed and detached from the real world...
